items.title: 19.6.1 Difference between Translation in Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu comparison of translation in prokaryotes and eukaryotes (PDF 140).

blocks.caption: Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes mein translation
rows: mRNA transcription ke foran baad translate hota, koi tabdeeli nahi.
mRNA pehle badla jata: introns nikalte, 5' cap aur 3' poly-A dum lagti hai.
Translation cytoplasm aur rough endoplasmic reticulum par.
Pehla amino acid badla hua: N-formyl-methionine.
Pehla amino acid methionine, bagair tabdeeli.

blocks.prompt: Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic translation mein do farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: 70S ya 80S ribosomes; pehla amino acid fMet ya Met; mRNA tabdeeli nahi ya cap, dum aur splicing; sirf cytoplasm ya cytoplasm aur rough ER.

items: Prokaryotes: 70S, fMet, tabdeeli nahi; eukaryotes: 80S, Met, tayyar shuda mRNA.
